comment: Betsy is a fine professor. Lectures do not have any real direction and its hard to tell if I actually learned anything from the class. There are weekly news quizzes which can be fairly difficult, and she takes long to return grades. She is very kind and passionate about journalism; however, I don't think I would personally take this course again.

Weekly news quizzes can be a little difficult, but if you read the Washington Post and take detailed notes you should be fine. Tests were okay, lots of memorization. Mostly talk about current events and watch clips or movies that relate. Ms.Mullen is really kind, you can tell she truly cares and offers lots of extra credit.

I really like Professor Mullen as a person, but not so much as a professor. I found her lectures to be kinda useless, as we spent much too long writing ledes. She has no fear to give Fs, in fact, she did so to the entire class, very frequently. I checked in and participated actively,  but found that she was preoccupied with other things.

Professor Mullen is the absolute gem of the journalism department and one of my favorite professors out there! Definitely take this class! It will make you a better writer and student overall, as well as more knowledgeable about what is going on around you. Prof. Mullen is supportive and caring and always willing to offer extra help and credit.

Prof Mullen is such a gem. The class is straightforward if you pay attention and skim the readings. There are weekly news quizzes on the Wash Post's coverage but if you actually read they're easy. Lots of extra credit opportunities and is very understanding about extensions and other commitments. Super interesting material. Would 10/10 recommend!

Definitely a lot of reading. Weekly quizzes on what's being covered by the news outlets you have to read. I didn't read everything that was assigned, and skipped over certain parts and that definitely cost me my grade.
Participation matters but it can be hard to participate if many others are. The weekly news quizzes are hard but she is so sweet!
A lot of reading involved in her class but it's all very interesting. She's very passionate about journalism and she makes sure all criteria and expectations are clear.

Professor Mullen is amazing! Class discussion is always interesting, and she is always willing to give extra credit opportunities and (reasonably) extend deadlines. You'd have to read the Post for the weekly quiz, but the course load overall is light. Definitely recommend!!

Betsy Mullen was an awesome professor. She and her husband are the power couple at UR and in the journalism department. Doable course load. You learn a lot about journalism and the news. A couple projects and writing assignments here and there, but main thing is keeping up with the news all semester for weekly news quizzes. Super nice woman.

Professor Mullen is definitely one of the best ones here at Richmond. She is kind, caring, and class activities are very interesting. There's a weekly news quiz, which is not too hard, and a lot of extra credit opportunities. If you need are interested in journalism or need a credit definitely take her class.
I love her! Pretty easy class besides the weekly current event quizzes but she gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and is super understanding about issues. Would definitely take her again
Betsy is one of the best from the Journalism department- She is so understanding and is an extremely fair grader. If you care about her class, you will do well.
Mullen: One of if not the most endearing professors I've had on campus. Super chill and laid-back. Work is graded very carefully and there is a good deal of it. But overall highly recommend
She is super nice and the class was pretty interesting. Overall, the most important thing is to do your current events readings and study for the tests. I would def take her again.

News quizzes every week, and if you get one question wrong its -10 points so it is hard to do well. However, she gives a lot of opportunity for extra credit (I received 55 extra credit points). A few tests on books so you have to read them. Brought her dog to class a few times! Interesting class and would definitely recommend, I really enjoyed it.

Betsy (yes, she told us to call her by her first name) is a great professor. She is very down-to-earth and knowledgeable in her field. She will help you if you ask and gives good feedback on homework and other assignments. She gives a lot of extra credit and really values effort and improvement. Take one of Betsy's classes if you get the chance!

Professor Mullen is great. She taught our class a ton about news and how to write it. Attendance is important, but if you have any interest in the topic, you'll really find yourself looking forward to class. She's an easy grader and rewards improvement and is always available to help. Vey accommodating and super nice as well.

Mrs. Mullen is a former journalist with a wealth of real-world experience about how to write and report. She's not easy, but she's never discouraging. Even though I had her 3 semesters ago, I still make sure to drop by her office during the few hours each week she's on campus to shoot the breeze. She's sharp, but sweet.

She is a very nice professor. She is somewhat more like a mother than a professor which is a good thing. She cares a lot about her students. Her classes are always interesting. However, her writing assignments can be extremely challenging!

Mrs. Mullen is the sweetest, most sincere person ever. She really cares about her students and is very accessible. Her homework is challenging, but she's willing to work with you. Overall, if you put in average effort you will probably get a B+. If you show you care, she will reciprocate. If you're homesick, she is your mom away from home!
Can't believe nobody has rated her as a hottie, cause she is. She's also an extremely nice woman and a good features writing teacher.
Great person all around. She knows her stuff and cares deeply about both journalism and her students. There should be more profs like her.
